classification.summary: KiloEx's BSC MinimalForwarder exposes a public execute((address,address,uint256,uint256,uint256,bytes),bytes) entry point that relays any request with a valid signature but omits the keeper and approved-router authorization enforced by its other relay entry point. Because the request chooses its own signer and the downstream delegate trusts msg.sender == the forwarder without checking the appended ERC-2771 sender, the attacker used a self-generated signer to reach the privileged price-and-trade path, set artificial prices, and trade against KiloEx's USDT vault.

loss.notes: Three calls using the unguarded forwarder entry point define the BSC campaign. In the first two, KiloEx USDT vault 0xef7af0804aab3885da59a8236fabfa19ddc6cf48 loses a transaction-local net 892947.452212280000000000 and 61974.379910380000000000 USDT. In the third, the attacker directly relays USDT.transfer through the forwarder and removes 4306.800000000000000000 USDT of accumulated KiloEx fees. The resulting gross KiloEx outflow is 959228.632122660000000000 USDT; the attacker EOA receives 959217.079253360000000000 USDT, with the difference going to flash-loan and protocol fees. This record covers BSC only and does not include the separately recorded Base loss or the out-of-scope opBNB leg. Later recovery under the cross-chain bounty agreement is not netted out of the exploit-time gross loss.

lastCodeChange.description: The second and final pre-exploit Upgraded event from the forwarder proxy selected implementation 0xd8240094e57bf5f893420ffc1e750c94de4a4177. The EIP-1967 implementation slot changes from 0xde6f7616d7a18831445ca064a0351c4b603aad2b at block 47331738 to 0xd8240094e57bf5f893420ffc1e750c94de4a4177 at block 47331739 and still holds the latter address immediately before the exploit.

sources.note: Anchor kept as the first of the three BSC campaign transactions. Attacker EOA 0x00fac92881556a90fdb19eae9f23640b95b4bcbd created exploit contract 0xcc6a5784194bd516db29aa505179857025d8bef4 at block 48357841, then called it twice at blocks 48358304 and 48358423; it called the vulnerable forwarder directly at block 48359406. callTracer on the anchor shows exploit contract -> KiloEx router 0x298e94d5494e7c461a05903dcf41910e0125d019 -> forwarder proxy 0xad37c86c06be706466ee70cbbf58f20655e7efb1 selector 0x47153f82 -> DELEGATECALL implementation 0xd8240094e57bf5f893420ffc1e750c94de4a4177 -> delegate collection 0xaf457b72fff6712641c5f1843515a6e114b2ecde selector 0xac9fd279. At block 48358303, forged signer 0x551f3110f12c763d1611d5a63b5f015d1c1a954c has isKeeper=false and nonce=0, while approvedRouters(0xaf457b72fff6712641c5f1843515a6e114b2ecde)=true. The implementation runtime hash is exactly 0xca3ef4513e1e310d392809cc65aab1738b466192d2ea96f7ed1ca2f0d76fa10e, identical to the reviewed Base implementation and therefore assigned the same bytecode-level failure identity. The proxy was created by 0x1d568fc08a1d3978985bc3e896a22abd1222abcf at block 47272034, tx index 74. Its two pre-exploit Upgraded logs were enumerated: creation selected 0xde6f7616d7a18831445ca064a0351c4b603aad2b, and block 47331739 tx 0x1d96b8a03565d8ef5ad133e7e57d27fe66f240e5e4eda0f9cd304f6d9839ca3d index 117 log 402 selected 0xd8240094e57bf5f893420ffc1e750c94de4a4177. The EIP-1967 slot confirms that transition and retains 0xd8240094e57bf5f893420ffc1e750c94de4a4177 through block 48358303; its runtime hash is unchanged from activation through the exploit, establishing age 3079913 seconds. Loss was recomputed from USDT Transfer logs in the three campaign receipts: KiloEx vault 0xef7af0804aab3885da59a8236fabfa19ddc6cf48 loses net 954921.832122660000000000 USDT in the two price-manipulation transactions, and the forwarder loses 4306.800000000000000000 accumulated fee USDT in the final direct relay. The attacker EOA receives 959217.079253360000000000 USDT; 11.552869300000000000 USDT of the victim outflow is retained as flash-loan and protocol fees. USDT is valued at par. Base is a separate record and opBNB is excluded from this corpus, so neither is counted here.
